svg.title: The full framed restricted cotangent complex
svg.desc: The finite proper adjoint de Rham complex maps by evaluation to its fibre at the chosen point. The dual fibre formula represents all split square-zero lifts. Evaluation is injective on horizontal sections over every residue field; dual surjectivity cancels the top cells and proves compact connective Tor amplitude minus one through zero. The examples distinguish this bound from unobstructedness and retain all higher groups on an unbounded coefficient algebra.
svg.text: A compact connective cotangent module on every DG base
Smooth projective complex X, chosen x, connected reductive H; full connective coefficient A.
1. The actual proper complex and its evaluation — DCT.1–DCT.3
C_F=RΓ_dR(X_A,ad P); e_x:C_F → (ad P)_x; K_F=Fib(e_x).
Two affine Čech columns and two de Rham terms give a perfect A-module.
C_F has relative Tor amplitude [0,2]; all nonflat scalar changes are retained.
The connection differential is A-linear; it is not O_X-linear.
2. Linearize all split lifts, including higher paths — DCT.4–DCT.7
A⊕M: transition correction a, connection correction θ, gauge frame 1−γ.
Total differential: δ+(−1)^q∇ in Čech degree q, with the internal DG signs.
Def_fr(M)=Ω∞((K_F⊗_A M)[1]); the nilpotent comparison gives the restricted lifts.
3. Finite duality gives the actual universal module — DCT.8–DCT.10
Def_fr(M)=Ω∞RHom_A(L_fr,M), naturally in every connective M.
Without a frame: L_unfr=C_F^∨[−1].
The frame triangle is L_unfr → L_fr → h^∨⊗A.
C_F^∨ corepresents maps from the coadjoint value to constants — DCT.13.
4. Connectivity is a finite cancellation argument — DCT.11–DCT.12
Over each residue field: horizontal sections inject into the fibre at x.
Dual evaluation is onto in degree zero.
In the finite model with relative generators −1,0,1, cancel the top pivot block.
L_fr is compact, connective, and of Tor amplitude [−1,0] over the whole A.
5. Tangent and obstruction groups are both necessary — DCT.14–DCT.22
Over ℂ, constant point in genus g: tangent dimension 2g·dim H; obstruction dim H.
P¹: L_fr=h^∨[1]; its ordinary tangent is zero and its obstruction space is h.
Elliptic GL₂ with U=[[1,1],[0,1]], V=I₂: tangent6, obstruction2.
Elliptic SL₂: εE₁₂ and εE₂₁ commute modulo ε², but cannot lift modulo ε³.
Their product difference is ε²·diag(1,−1), independently of all second-order choices.
6. Unbounded A retains all higher derivative groups — DCT.23–DCT.25
A=ℂ[z], |z|=−2; M=A; base point is the trivial framed connection.
π_(2r) Def_fr(A)=h^(2g) z^r (r≥0).
π_(2r−1) Def_fr(A)=h z^r (r≥1).
Iterated interval forms represent every group; no coefficient degree is discarded.
Effective derived ind-affine stages and their whole convergent point functor are additional.
Proof locators: §§3.128–3.135. Tensor framework: AGKRRV, arXiv:2010.01906v2.
